title: AVSD: Adaptive-View Self-Distillation by Balancing Consensus and Teacher-Specific Privileged Signals
abstract: arXiv:2605.20643v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Self-distillation enables language models to learn on-policy from their own trajectories by using the same model as both student and teacher, with the teacher being conditioned on privileged information unavailable to the student. Such information can come in different types or views, such as solutions, demonstrations, feedback, or final answers. This setup provides dense token-level feedback without relying on a separate external model, but creates a fundamental asymmetry: the teacher may rely on view-specific information that the student cannot access at inference time. Moreover, the best type of privileged information is often task-dependent, making it difficult to choose a single teacher view. In this work, we address both these challenges jointly by introducing AVSD (Adaptive-View Self-Distillation), a novel method of self-distillation with multiple privileged-information views, which reconstructs token-level supervision b

translated_title: AVSD：通过平衡共识信号与教师特定特权信号的自适应视图自蒸馏
translated_abstract: 自蒸馏使语言模型能够从自身的轨迹中进行在线学习，其方法是将同一个模型同时用作学生和教师，其中教师以学生无法获取的特权信息为条件。这类信息可以来自不同的类型或视图，例如解题方案、示范、反馈或最终答案。这种设置无需依赖单独的外部模型即可提供密集的 token 级反馈，但会产生一个根本性的不对称问题：教师可能依赖于学生在推理时无法访问的视图特定信息。此外，最佳类型的特权信息往往取决于具体任务，因此难以选择单一的教师视图。在本工作中，我们通过提出 AVSD（自适应视图自蒸馏）来联合解决这两个挑战，这是一种使用多种特权信息视图的新型自蒸馏方法，它重构了 token 级监督……（摘要内容被截断）
tldr: 本文提出 AVSD（自适应视图自蒸馏）方法，通过平衡共识信号与教师特定特权信号，在多种特权信息视图之间自适应地进行自蒸馏，从而联合解决了师生信息不对称和特权信息类型因任务而异这两个难题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AVSD (Adaptive-View Self-Distillation), a novel self-distillation method that balances consensus and teacher-specific privileged signals across multiple privileged-information views, jointly addressing the teacher-student information asymmetry and the task-dependent difficulty of selecting a single teacher view.
